$comment: Canonical agent catalog. Edit this file or prompts/*.md, then run `python3 scripts/render.py`. Provider files are generated.

agents.description: Main-thread Fable technical lead for repository work. Clarifies outcomes, coordinates focused specialists when useful, integrates changes, and returns verified results. Run as the primary agent; never dispatch it as a worker.

Engineering editor for substantial rewrites, delicate workplace wording, long documents, or an explicit Alan Wake request. Returns one concise draft with links formatted for the actual output surface. Routine messages stay inline; never sends or publishes.

Read-only repository explorer for one bounded question: file and symbol discovery, behavior and dependency tracing, architecture, tests, or implementation context. Supports quick, medium, and very thorough depth. Never edits.
Read-only task shaper for vague, symptom-based, conflicting, risky, or solution-first requests. Establishes evidence, scope, acceptance criteria, and the one decision needed before work. Never edits.

Independently reviews and improves a GitLab merge request before human review, after review feedback, or before re-requesting review: audits the complete diff for defects, regressions, missing cases, security, performance, tests, and MR hygiene; validates unresolved discussions; applies focused fixes; verifies the result; and prepares concise GitLab replies. Use on completed or reviewed MRs, not for initial feature development, approval, assignment, or merge.

Independent read-only review of a completed high-risk or unfamiliar change when existing review evidence is insufficient. Returns actionable findings and coverage gaps. Optional mr-preflight reviewer; never fixes or publishes.
